Technical Specifications This document establishes the performance, design and acceptance requirements for the Elec tronic Time Fuze for Shell 155MM with Self Destruction (SD) Mechanism. 1.1 Description of the Product It is the Time Fuze used for Air burst of Carrier Projectiles for 155MM Ammunition. The outer di mensions of the Fuze are as per Annexure-I. Fuze should be supplied with required electrical i nitiators and other components. The explosive part of the Fuze that is required to initiate the main charge will be in the scope of OFDR and the same will be supplied as a free supply to the firm for required number of Fuz es. 1.2 Function Mode The FUZE should have two modes of operation i.e. Time Mode (with Impact as Backup) and Poi nt Detonation Mode (PDSQ).FUZE Functioning can be selected between two modes with the he lp of an Inductive Setter. Time Setting can be done from 3 seconds to 199.9 second with an in crement of 0.1 second. Ø Time Mode: Function at set time. Ø Point Detonating: When set to PD Mode, the Fuze functions instantly on impact. Ø Self-Destruction (SD): The FUZE should incorporate self-destruction feature to initiate munitions in case the FUZE fails to function in the primary mode. Self-destruction sho uld be in the range of 190 to 210 Second and it should be programmable as per custo mer requirement. Ø Explosive Ordnance Discharge (EOD): Fuze should have the features incorporated for safe handling in case of total failure.

1.3 Safety Mechanism v Safety & Arming: Fuze should have safe & arm device preventing unintended arming and should get armed only after achieving setback & spin forces. v Battery Activation: Battery should always be in inactive mode and should be activated o nly in the launch environment i.e. on receipt of the setback force & Spin. v Electronic Arming Safety: Fuze should have electronic programmable safety feature inc orporated so that it should not function in case of round stuck in the barrel. 1.4 Technical Data Ø Overall length:133.8 mm (Max) Ø Intrusion Thread: 2”-12UNS-1A Ø Intrusion Depth: 38.1mm(max) Ø Cross Section Diameter: 61.20/ 60.80 mm Ø Power supply: Reserve Battery Ø Temperature range of use: -30ºC to + 55ºC Ø Temperature range of storage: -40ºC to + 70ºC Ø Shelf life: 10 years minimum Ø Fuze should comply Mil-STD-331 & MIL-STD-1316 1.5 Critical Subassemblies: Ø Battery Ø Electric Initiator Ø Firing Control Circuit & Time Setting Circuit Ø Safety & Arming Device 1.6 Packaging: FUZE to be packed individually in hermetically sealed plast ic containers. 20 such containers will be packed in metal boxes that ha ve Styrofoam inner trays or participating firm can suggest as per their design. 2. Technical Specifications of Inductive Fuze Setter 2.1 It should be the Inductive Fuze Setter compatible with all the Electronic Artil lery Fuzes and should set functional modes and required timings for Electronic Time Fuzes. 2.2 It should be easy to handle for reading and setting of Fuzes. 2.3 It should be capable of Fuze Setting time from 3 Seconds to 199.9 Seconds with minimum increment of 0.1 second. 2.4 It should be capable of reading the Fuze status through display including m ode, time etc before and after setting of Fuze. 2.5 The Fuze settings over display should be readable during day & night also. 2.6 It should be capable for repeated changes in fuze settings. 2.7 It should be operated using easily replaceable batteries. 3. Technical Specifications This document establishes the performance, design and acceptance requirements for the Elec tronic Time Fuze for Shell 155MM with Self Destruction (SD) Mechanism. 1.1 Description of the Product It is the Time Fuze used for Air burst of Carrier Projectiles for 155MM Ammunition. The outer di mensions of the Fuze are as per Annexure-I. Fuze should be supplied with required electrical i nitiators and other components. The explosive part of the Fuze that is required to initiate the main charge will be in the scope of OFDR and the same will be supplied as a free supply to the firm for required number of Fuz es. 1.2 Function Mode The FUZE should have two modes of operation i.e. Time Mode (with Impact as Backup) and Poi nt Detonation Mode (PDSQ).FUZE Functioning can be selected between two modes with the he lp of an Inductive Setter. Time Setting can be done from 3 seconds to 199.9 second with an in crement of 0.1 second. Ø Time Mode: Function at set time. Ø Point Detonating: When set to PD Mode, the Fuze functions instantly on impact. Ø Self-Destruction (SD): The FUZE should incorporate self-destruction feature to initiate munitions in case the FUZE fails to function in the primary mode. Self-destruction sho uld be in the range of 190 to 210 Second and it should be programmable as per custo mer requirement. Ø Explosive Ordnance Discharge (EOD): Fuze should have the features incorporated for safe handling in case of total failure.

1.3 Safety Mechanism v Safety & Arming: Fuze should have safe & arm device preventing unintended arming and should get armed only after achieving setback & spin forces. v Battery Activation: Battery should always be in inactive mode and should be activated o nly in the launch environment i.e. on receipt of the setback force & Spin. v Electronic Arming Safety: Fuze should have electronic programmable safety feature inc orporated so that it should not function in case of round stuck in the barrel. 1.4 Technical Data Ø Overall length:133.8 mm (Max) Ø Intrusion Thread: 2”-12UNS-1A Ø Intrusion Depth: 38.1mm(max) Ø Cross Section Diameter: 61.20/ 60.80 mm Ø Power supply: Reserve Battery Ø Temperature range of use: -30ºC to + 55ºC Ø Temperature range of storage: -40ºC to + 70ºC Ø Shelf life: 10 years minimum Ø Fuze should comply Mil-STD-331 & MIL-STD-1316 1.5 Critical Subassemblies: Ø Battery Ø Electric Initiator Ø Firing Control Circuit & Time Setting Circuit Ø Safety & Arming Device 1.6 Packaging: FUZE to be packed individually in hermetically sealed plast ic containers. 20 such containers will be packed in metal boxes that ha ve Styrofoam inner trays or participating firm can suggest as per their design. 2. Technical Specifications of Inductive Fuze Setter 2.1 It should be the Inductive Fuze Setter compatible with all the Electronic Artil lery Fuzes and should set functional modes and required timings for Electronic Time Fuzes. 2.2 It should be easy to handle for reading and setting of Fuzes. 2.3 It should be capable of Fuze Setting time from 3 Seconds to 199.9 Seconds with minimum increment of 0.1 second. 2.4 It should be capable of reading the Fuze status through display including m ode, time etc before and after setting of Fuze. 2.5 The Fuze settings over display should be readable during day & night also. 2.6 It should be capable for repeated changes in fuze settings. 2.7 It should be operated using easily replaceable batteries. 3.
